title: Wish I'd seen stems weren't included. Nice color but impractical.
text: Wish I'd seen stems weren't included. Nice color but impractical.. Didn't see they didn't come with a stem. Made it very difficult to use a fillers in arrangements and in the Christmas tree. Next time I read more closely. Nice deep color, I just wish they had the stems. Won't buy again.
